```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(corrplot)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggpubr)
library(Hmisc)
library(patchwork)

# 1. SETUP OUTPUT DIRECTORY ------------------------------------------------

output_dir <- "Pseudomonas_Food_Analysis_Precise"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir)

plot_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "Plots")
table_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "Tables")
dirs_to_create <- c(plot_dir, table_dir)
for(dir in dirs_to_create) if (!dir.exists(dir)) dir.create(dir)

log_file <- file.path(output_dir, "analysis_log.txt")
sink(log_file, split = TRUE)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("Pseudomonas-Food Association Analysis (Precise)\n")
cat("Started:", Sys.time(), "\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# 2. PREPARE THE DATA -----------------------------------------------------

cat("Step 1: Preparing data...\n")

# Rename columns
species_data_clean <- species_data
colnames(species_data_clean)[1] <- "Participant_ID"

# Clean food_data_250
if("freg0_pid" %in% colnames(food_data_250)) {
  food_data_250_clean <- food_data_250 %>%
    rename(Participant_ID = participant_id) %>%
    dplyr::select(-freg0_pid)
} else {
  food_data_250_clean <- food_data_250 %>%
    rename(Participant_ID = participant_id)
}

if(colnames(food_data)[1] != "Participant_ID") {
  colnames(food_data)[1] <- "Participant_ID"
}

# 3. CREATE SEPARATE MERGED DATASETS ---------------------------------------

cat("\nStep 2: Creating separate merged datasets...\n")

merged_groups <- merge(species_data_clean, food_data, by = "Participant_ID", all = FALSE)
merged_items <- merge(species_data_clean, food_data_250_clean, by = "Participant_ID", all = FALSE)

cat("Food groups dataset:", dim(merged_groups), "\n")
cat("Food items dataset:", dim(merged_items), "\n")

# 4. PRECISE PSEUDOMONAS IDENTIFICATION -----------------------------------

cat("\nStep 3: Precise Pseudomonas identification...\n")

# Get all species columns
all_species <- colnames(species_data_clean)[-1]

# STRATEGY:
# 1. First find all columns that start with "Pseudomonas" (case insensitive)
# 2. Remove those that are actually other genera (like Rhodopseudomonas)
# 3. Separate into species-level and genus-level entries

# Find all columns containing "pseudomonas" (case insensitive)
all_pseudo_cols <- all_species[grepl("pseudomonas", all_species, ignore.case = TRUE)]

cat("\nAll columns containing 'pseudomonas':\n")
print(all_pseudo_cols)

# Filter 1: Keep only those that START with Pseudomonas (case insensitive)
# This removes things like "Rhodopseudomonas" which starts with Rhodopseudomonas
true_pseudomonas <- all_pseudo_cols[grepl("^pseudomonas", all_pseudo_cols, ignore.case = TRUE)]

cat("\nColumns starting with 'Pseudomonas':\n")
print(true_pseudomonas)

# Filter 2: Separate into proper species and "sp." entries
# Proper species: Pseudomonas followed by space and a lowercase word (species name)
# "sp." entries: Pseudomonas followed by "sp."
# Unidentified: Pseudomonas with numbers or other patterns

# Pattern for proper species: "Pseudomonas amygdali", "Pseudomonas aeruginosa", etc.
# Should have: Pseudomonas + space + word (not starting with sp, SP, or numbers)
species_pattern <- "^[Pp]seudomonas\\s+[a-z]"
proper_species <- true_pseudomonas[grepl(species_pattern, true_pseudomonas, ignore.case = TRUE) & 
                                   !grepl("\\s+sp\\.", true_pseudomonas, ignore.case = TRUE)]

# Pattern for "sp." entries
sp_pattern <- "\\s+sp\\.|\\s+SP\\.|\\s+Sp\\."
sp_entries <- true_pseudomonas[grepl(sp_pattern, true_pseudomonas, ignore.case = TRUE)]

# Other patterns (numbers, etc.)
other_pseudo <- setdiff(true_pseudomonas, c(proper_species, sp_entries))

cat("\n=== Pseudomonas Classification Results ===\n")
cat("\nProper Pseudomonas species (identified species):\n")
if(length(proper_species) > 0) {
  for(s in proper_species) cat("  -", s, "\n")
} else {
  cat("  None found\n")
}

cat("\nPseudomonas sp. entries (unidentified species):\n")
if(length(sp_entries) > 0) {
  for(s in sp_entries) cat("  -", s, "\n")
} else {
  cat("  None found\n")
}

cat("\nOther Pseudomonas patterns:\n")
if(length(other_pseudo) > 0) {
  for(s in other_pseudo) cat("  -", s, "\n")
} else {
  cat("  None found\n")
}

# Save classification info
pseudo_classification <- data.frame(
  Original_Name = c(proper_species, sp_entries, other_pseudo),
  Type = c(rep("Proper_Species", length(proper_species)),
           rep("Sp_Entry", length(sp_entries)),
           rep("Other_Pattern", length(other_pseudo))),
  Included_in_Species_Analysis = c(rep("YES", length(proper_species)),
                                   rep("NO", length(sp_entries)),
                                   rep("NO", length(other_pseudo))),
  Included_in_Genus_Analysis = c(rep("YES", length(proper_species)),
                                 rep("YES", length(sp_entries)),
                                 rep("YES", length(other_pseudo)))
)

write.csv(pseudo_classification, 
          file.path(table_dir, "01_pseudomonas_classification.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

# 5. CREATE ANALYSIS VARIABLES --------------------------------------------

cat("\nStep 4: Creating analysis variables...\n")

# For SPECIES-LEVEL analysis: only proper species
target_species <- proper_species
cat("\nSpecies for individual analysis:", length(target_species), "\n")
if(length(target_species) > 0) print(target_species)

# For GENUS-LEVEL analysis: ALL Pseudomonas (proper species + sp. entries + others)
# But we need to check which ones are actually in our merged data
all_pseudomonas_for_genus <- true_pseudomonas  # All that start with Pseudomonas

# Check availability in merged data
available_in_groups <- intersect(all_pseudomonas_for_genus, colnames(merged_groups))
available_in_items <- intersect(all_pseudomonas_for_genus, colnames(merged_items))

cat("\nAvailable for genus analysis in groups data:", length(available_in_groups), "/", length(all_pseudomonas_for_genus), "\n")
cat("Available for genus analysis in items data:", length(available_in_items), "/", length(all_pseudomonas_for_genus), "\n")

# Create Pseudomonas genus column for both datasets
create_pseudomonas_genus_column <- function(data, pseudo_cols) {
  available_cols <- intersect(pseudo_cols, colnames(data))
  cat("  Using", length(available_cols), "Pseudomonas columns for genus sum\n")
  if(length(available_cols) > 0) {
    data$Pseudomonas_genus <- rowSums(data[, available_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Also add a presence/absence column
    data$Pseudomonas_genus_presence <- as.numeric(data$Pseudomonas_genus > 0)
    
    # Log summary
    cat("  Genus summary - Mean:", mean(data$Pseudomonas_genus, na.rm = TRUE), 
        "Prevalence:", mean(data$Pseudomonas_genus_presence, na.rm = TRUE)*100, "%\n")
  } else {
    cat("  WARNING: No Pseudomonas columns found for genus calculation\n")
    data$Pseudomonas_genus <- NA
    data$Pseudomonas_genus_presence <- NA
  }
  return(data)
}

cat("\nCreating Pseudomonas genus column for groups data...\n")
merged_groups <- create_pseudomonas_genus_column(merged_groups, all_pseudomonas_for_genus)

cat("\nCreating Pseudomonas genus column for items data...\n")
merged_items <- create_pseudomonas_genus_column(merged_items, all_pseudomonas_for_genus)

# Final target variables
target_vars_groups <- c(intersect(target_species, colnames(merged_groups)), 
                       "Pseudomonas_genus", "Pseudomonas_genus_presence")
target_vars_items <- c(intersect(target_species, colnames(merged_items)), 
                      "Pseudomonas_genus", "Pseudomonas_genus_presence")

cat("\n=== Final Target Variables ===\n")
cat("\nFor Food Groups analysis:\n")
for(v in target_vars_groups) cat("  -", v, "\n")

cat("\nFor Food Items analysis:\n")
for(v in target_vars_items) cat("  -", v, "\n")

# Save target variables
write.csv(data.frame(Variable = target_vars_groups, Dataset = "Food_Groups"),
          file.path(table_dir, "02_target_variables_groups.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(Variable = target_vars_items, Dataset = "Food_Items"),
          file.path(table_dir, "03_target_variables_items.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# 6. GET FOOD COLUMNS ------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nStep 5: Identifying food columns...\n")

food_group_cols <- setdiff(colnames(food_data), "Participant_ID")
food_group_cols <- intersect(food_group_cols, colnames(merged_groups))

food_item_cols <- setdiff(colnames(food_data_250_clean), "Participant_ID")
food_item_cols <- intersect(food_item_cols, colnames(merged_items))

cat("Food groups:", length(food_group_cols), "\n")
cat("Food items:", length(food_item_cols), "\n")

# 7. CORRELATION ANALYSIS FUNCTION ---------------------------------------

calculate_correlations_precise <- function(pseudomonas_vars, food_cols, data, data_name = "") {
  all_results <- data.frame()
  
  for(pseudo_var in pseudomonas_vars) {
    cat("\n  Analyzing:", pseudo_var)
    
    if(!pseudo_var %in% colnames(data)) {
      cat(" - NOT FOUND in data\n")
      next
    }
    
    var_results <- data.frame()
    
    for(food in food_cols) {
      if(food %in% colnames(data)) {
        # Remove NAs
        complete_cases <- complete.cases(data[[pseudo_var]], data[[food]])
        
        if(sum(complete_cases) >= 10) {  # Minimum sample size
          cor_test <- tryCatch({
            cor.test(data[[pseudo_var]][complete_cases],
                    data[[food]][complete_cases],
                    method = "spearman")
          }, error = function(e) NULL)
          
          if(!is.null(cor_test)) {
            var_results <- rbind(var_results, data.frame(
              Pseudomonas_var = pseudo_var,
              Food = food,
              Correlation = cor_test$estimate,
              P_value = cor_test$p.value,
              N = sum(complete_cases),
              Data_type = data_name,
              stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            ))
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Adjust p-values for this Pseudomonas variable
    if(nrow(var_results) > 0) {
      var_results$P_adj <- p.adjust(var_results$P_value, method = "BH")
      all_results <- rbind(all_results, var_results)
    }
  }
  
  return(all_results)
}

# 8. RUN SEPARATE ANALYSES ------------------------------------------------

cat("\n\nStep 6: Running correlation analyses...\n")

cat("\nA) Food Groups analysis...\n")
all_cor_groups <- calculate_correlations_precise(target_vars_groups, food_group_cols, 
                                                 merged_groups, "Food_Group")

cat("\nB) Food Items analysis...\n")
all_cor_items <- calculate_correlations_precise(target_vars_items, food_item_cols,
                                                merged_items, "Food_Item")

cat("\nCorrelations calculated:\n")
cat("  Food groups:", nrow(all_cor_groups), "\n")
cat("  Food items:", nrow(all_cor_items), "\n")

# 9. IDENTIFY SIGNIFICANT ASSOCIATIONS -----------------------------------

sig_threshold <- 0.05

sig_cor_groups <- all_cor_groups %>%
  filter(P_adj < sig_threshold) %>%
  arrange(P_adj, desc(abs(Correlation)))

sig_cor_items <- all_cor_items %>%
  filter(P_adj < sig_threshold) %>%
  arrange(P_adj, desc(abs(Correlation)))

cat("\nSignificant associations (FDR < 0.05):\n")
cat("  Food groups:", nrow(sig_cor_groups), "\n")
cat("  Food items:", nrow(sig_cor_items), "\n")

# 10. SAVE RESULTS --------------------------------------------------------

write.csv(all_cor_groups, file.path(table_dir, "04_all_correlations_groups.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(all_cor_items, file.path(table_dir, "05_all_correlations_items.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

if(nrow(sig_cor_groups) > 0) {
  write.csv(sig_cor_groups, file.path(table_dir, "06_significant_groups.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
if(nrow(sig_cor_items) > 0) {
  write.csv(sig_cor_items, file.path(table_dir, "07_significant_items.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```


```{r}
cat("\nStep 7: Creating visualizations...\n")

# Function to create summary plot
create_summary_plot <- function(sig_data, title_suffix, color_scheme) {
  if(nrow(sig_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  summary_data <- sig_data %>%
    group_by(Pseudomonas_var) %>%
    summarise(
      n_associations = n(),
      mean_correlation = mean(Correlation),
      perc_positive = sum(Correlation > 0) / n() * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = reorder(Pseudomonas_var, mean_correlation), 
                                y = mean_correlation,
                                fill = ifelse(mean_correlation > 0, "Positive", "Negative"))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_associations), 
              hjust = ifelse(summary_data$mean_correlation > 0, -0.2, 1.2),
              size = 3) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = paste("Summary:", title_suffix),
         subtitle = paste("Total", nrow(sig_data), "significant associations"),
         x = "Pseudomonas Variable", y = "Mean Correlation Coefficient",
         fill = "Direction") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_scheme)
  
  return(p)
}

# Plot for food groups
if(nrow(sig_cor_groups) > 0) {
  p1 <- create_summary_plot(sig_cor_groups, "Food Groups", 
                           c("Positive" = "#2E86AB", "Negative" = "#A23B72"))
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "01_summary_food_groups.png"), p1, 
         width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  
  # Heatmap for top associations
  top_groups <- sig_cor_groups %>%
    group_by(Pseudomonas_var) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = abs(Correlation), n = 5) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  heatmap_data <- top_groups %>%
    dplyr::select(Pseudomonas_var, Food, Correlation) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Food, values_from = Correlation) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Pseudomonas_var")
  
  if(ncol(heatmap_data) > 1) {
    png(file.path(plot_dir, "02_heatmap_food_groups.png"), 
        width = 10, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
    pheatmap(heatmap_data,
             main = "Top Associations: Food Groups",
             color = colorRampPalette(c("#A23B72", "white", "#2E86AB"))(50))
    dev.off()
  }
}

# Plot for food items
if(nrow(sig_cor_items) > 0) {
  p2 <- create_summary_plot(sig_cor_items, "Food Items",
                           c("Positive" = "#3D5A80", "Negative" = "#EE6C4D"))
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "03_summary_food_items.png"), p2,
         width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  
  # Focus on top food items overall
  top_items_summary <- sig_cor_items %>%
    group_by(Food) %>%
    summarise(
      n_associations = n(),
      mean_correlation = mean(Correlation),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(mean_correlation))) %>%
    head(20)
  
  p3 <- ggplot(top_items_summary, aes(x = reorder(Food, mean_correlation), 
                                      y = mean_correlation,
                                      fill = ifelse(mean_correlation > 0, "Positive", "Negative"))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "Top Food Items Overall",
         x = "Food Item", y = "Mean Correlation Coefficient") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Positive" = "#3D5A80", "Negative" = "#EE6C4D"), guide = "none")
  
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "04_top_food_items.png"), p3, 
         width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}

# 12. COMPARISON: SPECIES VS GENUS ----------------------------------------

cat("\nStep 8: Comparing species vs genus associations...\n")

# Separate species and genus results
if(nrow(sig_cor_groups) > 0) {
  sig_cor_groups <- sig_cor_groups %>%
    mutate(Var_type = ifelse(grepl("genus", Pseudomonas_var, ignore.case = TRUE), 
                            "Genus", "Species"))
  
  # Compare number of associations
  comp_groups <- sig_cor_groups %>%
    group_by(Var_type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_variables = n_distinct(Pseudomonas_var),
      n_associations = n(),
      mean_abs_cor = mean(abs(Correlation)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  cat("\nFood Groups - Species vs Genus:\n")
  print(comp_groups)
}

if(nrow(sig_cor_items) > 0) {
  sig_cor_items <- sig_cor_items %>%
    mutate(Var_type = ifelse(grepl("genus", Pseudomonas_var, ignore.case = TRUE), 
                            "Genus", "Species"))
  
  comp_items <- sig_cor_items %>%
    group_by(Var_type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_variables = n_distinct(Pseudomonas_var),
      n_associations = n(),
      mean_abs_cor = mean(abs(Correlation)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  cat("\nFood Items - Species vs Genus:\n")
  print(comp_items)
}
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)

# 1. SETUP OUTPUT DIRECTORY ------------------------------------------------

output_dir <- "Pseudomonas_Genus_Associations"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir)

cat("Creating Pseudomonas genus association table...\n")

# 2. PREPARE THE DATA -----------------------------------------------------

# Rename columns
species_data_clean <- species_data
colnames(species_data_clean)[1] <- "Participant_ID"

# Clean food_data_250
if("freg0_pid" %in% colnames(food_data_250)) {
  food_data_250_clean <- food_data_250 %>%
    rename(Participant_ID = participant_id) %>%
    dplyr::select(-freg0_pid)
} else {
  food_data_250_clean <- food_data_250 %>%
    rename(Participant_ID = participant_id)
}

if(colnames(food_data)[1] != "Participant_ID") {
  colnames(food_data)[1] <- "Participant_ID"
}

# 3. CREATE PSEUDOMONAS GENUS COLUMN --------------------------------------

# Find all Pseudomonas columns (proper ones that start with Pseudomonas)
all_species <- colnames(species_data_clean)[-1]
pseudomonas_cols <- all_species[grepl("^pseudomonas", all_species, ignore.case = TRUE)]

cat("\nFound", length(pseudomonas_cols), "Pseudomonas columns for genus calculation\n")

# Merge with food groups
merged_groups <- merge(species_data_clean, food_data, by = "Participant_ID", all = FALSE)
# Merge with food items
merged_items <- merge(species_data_clean, food_data_250_clean, by = "Participant_ID", all = FALSE)

# Create Pseudomonas genus column
create_genus_column <- function(data) {
  available_cols <- intersect(pseudomonas_cols, colnames(data))
  if(length(available_cols) > 0) {
    data$Pseudomonas_genus <- rowSums(data[, available_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    cat("  Used", length(available_cols), "columns for genus calculation\n")
  } else {
    stop("No Pseudomonas columns found for genus calculation")
  }
  return(data)
}

merged_groups <- create_genus_column(merged_groups)
merged_items <- create_genus_column(merged_items)

# 4. FUNCTION TO TEST GENUS ASSOCIATIONS ---------------------------------

test_genus_associations <- function(merged_data, food_cols, data_name) {
  results <- data.frame(
    Food = character(),
    Correlation = numeric(),
    P_value = numeric(),
    P_adj = numeric(),
    N = integer(),
    Data_type = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  cat("\nTesting Pseudomonas genus associations with", length(food_cols), data_name, "...\n")
  pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = length(food_cols), style = 3)
  
  for(i in seq_along(food_cols)) {
    food <- food_cols[i]
    
    if("Pseudomonas_genus" %in% colnames(merged_data) && food %in% colnames(merged_data)) {
      complete_cases <- complete.cases(merged_data$Pseudomonas_genus, merged_data[[food]])
      
      if(sum(complete_cases) >= 10) {
        cor_test <- tryCatch({
          cor.test(merged_data$Pseudomonas_genus[complete_cases],
                  merged_data[[food]][complete_cases],
                  method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)  # exact = FALSE to handle ties
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if(!is.null(cor_test)) {
          results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
            Food = food,
            Correlation = cor_test$estimate,
            P_value = cor_test$p.value,
            P_adj = NA,  # Will adjust later
            N = sum(complete_cases),
            Data_type = data_name,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          ))
        }
      }
    }
    setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  }
  close(pb)
  
  # Adjust p-values
  if(nrow(results) > 0) {
    results$P_adj <- p.adjust(results$P_value, method = "BH")
  }
  
  return(results)
}

# 5. RUN ASSOCIATION TESTS ------------------------------------------------

# Get food columns
food_group_cols <- setdiff(colnames(food_data), "Participant_ID")
food_group_cols <- intersect(food_group_cols, colnames(merged_groups))

food_item_cols <- setdiff(colnames(food_data_250_clean), "Participant_ID")
food_item_cols <- intersect(food_item_cols, colnames(merged_items))

cat("\nNumber of food groups:", length(food_group_cols))
cat("\nNumber of food items:", length(food_item_cols))

# Test associations
genus_groups <- test_genus_associations(merged_groups, food_group_cols, "Food_Group")
genus_items <- test_genus_associations(merged_items, food_item_cols, "Food_Item")

# Combine results
all_genus_results <- rbind(genus_groups, genus_items)

# 6. CREATE SIGNIFICANCE TABLE -------------------------------------------

cat("\n\nCreating significance tables...\n")

# Vectorized function to get significance symbol
get_significance_vectorized <- function(p_values) {
  sapply(p_values, function(p) {
    if(is.na(p)) return(NA)
    if(p < 0.001) return("***")
    if(p < 0.01) return("**")
    if(p < 0.05) return("*")
    if(p < 0.1) return(".")
    return("ns")
  })
}

# Add significance columns
all_genus_results <- all_genus_results %>%
  mutate(
    P_signif = get_significance_vectorized(P_value),
    P_adj_signif = get_significance_vectorized(P_adj),
    Direction = ifelse(Correlation > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
    Effect_size = case_when(
      abs(Correlation) >= 0.5 ~ "Large",
      abs(Correlation) >= 0.3 ~ "Medium",
      abs(Correlation) >= 0.1 ~ "Small",
      TRUE ~ "Very small"
    )
  )

# 7. CREATE FORMATTED TABLES ---------------------------------------------

# Table 1: All results
table_all <- all_genus_results %>%
  dplyr::select(Food, Data_type, Correlation, Direction, P_value, P_adj, 
                P_adj_signif, N, Effect_size) %>%
  arrange(Data_type, P_adj, desc(abs(Correlation)))

# Table 2: Significant results only (FDR < 0.05)
table_sig <- all_genus_results %>%
  filter(P_adj < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::select(Food, Data_type, Correlation, Direction, P_value, P_adj, 
                P_adj_signif, N, Effect_size) %>%
  arrange(Data_type, P_adj, desc(abs(Correlation)))

# Table 3: Summary by data type

summary_by_type <- all_genus_results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Data_type, P_adj_signif, Direction) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Mean_correlation = mean(Correlation),
    Min_correlation = min(Correlation),
    Max_correlation = max(Correlation),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Data_type, P_adj_signif, Direction)

# Table 4: Top associations
top_associations <- bind_rows(
  all_genus_results %>%
    filter(Data_type == "Food_Group") %>%
    arrange(P_adj, desc(abs(Correlation))) %>%
    head(10) %>%
    mutate(Rank = row_number()),
  all_genus_results %>%
    filter(Data_type == "Food_Item") %>%
    arrange(P_adj, desc(abs(Correlation))) %>%
    head(20) %>%  # More for food items since there are more
    mutate(Rank = row_number())
) %>%
  dplyr::select(Rank, Food, Data_type, Correlation, Direction, P_adj, P_adj_signif, N)

# 8. SAVE TABLES ---------------------------------------------------------

cat("\nSaving tables to Excel file...\n")

# Create a workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()

# Add worksheets
addWorksheet(wb, "All_Associations")
addWorksheet(wb, "Significant_FDR_0.05")
addWorksheet(wb, "Summary_by_Type")
addWorksheet(wb, "Top_Associations")
addWorksheet(wb, "Pseudomonas_Info")

# Write data

writeData(wb, "Significant_FDR_0.05", table_sig)
writeData(wb, "Summary_by_Type", summary_by_type)
writeData(wb, "Top_Associations", top_associations)

# Add Pseudomonas information
pseudomonas_info <- data.frame(
  Item = c("Pseudomonas columns used", "Total food groups tested", 
           "Total food items tested", "Significant food groups (FDR<0.05)",
           "Significant food items (FDR<0.05)", "Analysis date"),
  Value = c(length(pseudomonas_cols), length(food_group_cols), length(food_item_cols),
            nrow(filter(table_sig, Data_type == "Food_Group")),
            nrow(filter(table_sig, Data_type == "Food_Item")),
            as.character(Sys.time()))
)
writeData(wb, "Pseudomonas_Info", pseudomonas_info)

# Add analysis information
analysis_info <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Correlation method", "P-value adjustment", 
                "Significance threshold", "Minimum sample size",
                "Pseudomonas genus calculation", "Columns excluded"),
  Value = c("Spearman correlation", "Benjamini-Hochberg (FDR)", 
            "P_adj < 0.05", "n >= 10", 
            "Sum of all Pseudomonas columns", 
            "Non-Pseudomonas (e.g., Rhodopseudomonas)")
)
writeData(wb, "Analysis_Info", analysis_info)

# Apply some formatting
# Format p-values
pval_style <- createStyle(numFmt = "0.00E+00")
if(nrow(table_all) > 0) {
  addStyle(wb, "All_Associations", style = pval_style, 
           rows = 2:(nrow(table_all)+1), cols = 5:6, gridExpand = TRUE)
}
if(nrow(table_sig) > 0) {
  addStyle(wb, "Significant_FDR_0.05", style = pval_style,
           rows = 2:(nrow(table_sig)+1), cols = 5:6, gridExpand = TRUE)
}
if(nrow(top_associations) > 0) {
  addStyle(wb, "Top_Associations", style = pval_style,
           rows = 2:(nrow(top_associations)+1), cols = 6, gridExpand = TRUE)
}

# Color code for significance
sig_style <- createStyle(fontColour = "#006400", textDecoration = "bold")
for(sheet in c("All_Associations", "Significant_FDR_0.05", "Top_Associations")) {
  if(sheet == "All_Associations" && nrow(table_all) > 0) {
    sig_rows <- which(table_all$P_adj < 0.05) + 1
  } else if(sheet == "Significant_FDR_0.05" && nrow(table_sig) > 0) {
    sig_rows <- 2:(nrow(table_sig)+1)  # All rows are significant
  } else if(sheet == "Top_Associations" && nrow(top_associations) > 0) {
    sig_rows <- 2:(nrow(top_associations)+1)  # All rows in top associations
  } else {
    sig_rows <- numeric(0)
  }
  
  if(length(sig_rows) > 0) {
    addStyle(wb, sheet, style = sig_style, rows = sig_rows, cols = 1:9, gridExpand = TRUE)
  }
}

# Save the workbook
excel_file <- file.path(output_dir, "Pseudomonas_genus_associations.xlsx")
saveWorkbook(wb, excel_file, overwrite = TRUE)
cat("Saved to:", excel_file, "\n")

# 9. CREATE SIMPLIFIED CSV FILES -----------------------------------------

cat("\nCreating simplified CSV files...\n")

# CSV 1: Significant associations only
if(nrow(table_sig) > 0) {
  write.csv(table_sig, 
            file.path(output_dir, "Pseudomonas_genus_significant_associations.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Saved significant associations to CSV\n")
} else {
  cat("No significant associations found\n")
}

# CSV 2: Summary table
# CSV 2: Summary table
summary_table <- all_genus_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Significant = ifelse(P_adj < 0.05, "Yes", "No")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Data_type, Significant, Direction) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Percentage = n() / nrow(all_genus_results) * 100,
    Mean_abs_correlation = mean(abs(Correlation)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(summary_table,
          file.path(output_dir, "Pseudomonas_genus_summary_table.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved summary table to CSV\n")

# 10. CREATE VISUALIZATION OF RESULTS ------------------------------------

cat("\nCreating visualization of results...\n")

# Plot 1: Volcano plot
if(nrow(all_genus_results) > 0) {
  p_volcano <- ggplot(all_genus_results, aes(x = Correlation, y = -log10(P_adj), 
                                             color = Data_type, shape = P_adj < 0.05)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.3) +
    labs(title = "Pseudomonas Genus Associations with Foods",
         subtitle = paste("Total tests:", nrow(all_genus_results), 
                         "| Significant (FDR<0.05):", nrow(table_sig)),
         x = "Correlation Coefficient", y = "-log10(Adjusted P-value)",
         color = "Data Type", shape = "FDR < 0.05") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Food_Group" = "#2E86AB", "Food_Item" = "#A23B72"))
  
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "volcano_plot_genus.png"), p_volcano, 
         width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  cat("Saved volcano plot\n")
}

# Plot 2: Top associations
if(nrow(table_sig) > 0) {
  # Get top 20 associations overall
  top_20 <- table_sig %>%
    arrange(P_adj, desc(abs(Correlation))) %>%
    head(20)
  
  p_top <- ggplot(top_20, aes(x = reorder(Food, Correlation), y = Correlation, 
                              fill = Data_type)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "Top 20 Significant Associations with Pseudomonas Genus",
         x = "Food", y = "Correlation Coefficient",
         fill = "Data Type") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Food_Group" = "#2E86AB", "Food_Item" = "#A23B72"))
  
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "top_associations_genus.png"), p_top, 
         width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  cat("Saved top associations plot\n")
}

# 11. CREATE TEXT SUMMARY -------------------------------------------------

cat("\nCreating text summary...\n")

sink(file.path(output_dir, "summary_report.txt"))
cat("PSEUDOMONAS GENUS ASSOCIATION ANALYSIS\n")

} else {

cat("\nSTRONGEST CORRELATIONS\n")

}
```

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(Hmisc)

# 1. Setup
output_dir <- "Pseudomonas_Genus_Results"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir)

# 2. Prepare data
# Create Pseudomonas genus column
species_data_clean <- species_data
colnames(species_data_clean)[1] <- "Participant_ID"

# Get all Pseudomonas columns
pseudomonas_cols <- colnames(species_data_clean)[-1]
pseudomonas_cols <- pseudomonas_cols[grepl("^pseudomonas", pseudomonas_cols, ignore.case = TRUE)]

# Merge datasets
merged_groups <- merge(species_data_clean, food_data, by = "Participant_ID", all = FALSE)
merged_items <- merge(species_data_clean, food_data_250, by.x = "Participant_ID", 
                      by.y = "participant_id", all = FALSE)

# Create genus columns
merged_groups$Pseudomonas_genus <- rowSums(merged_groups[, pseudomonas_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
merged_items$Pseudomonas_genus <- rowSums(merged_items[, pseudomonas_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

# 3. Function to test associations
test_associations <- function(data, food_cols, data_name) {
  results <- data.frame()
  
  for(food in food_cols) {
    if(food %in% colnames(data)) {
      complete_cases <- complete.cases(data$Pseudomonas_genus, data[[food]])
      
      if(sum(complete_cases) >= 10) {
        cor_test <- tryCatch({
          cor.test(data$Pseudomonas_genus[complete_cases],
                  data[[food]][complete_cases],
                  method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if(!is.null(cor_test)) {
          results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
            Food = food,
            Correlation = cor_test$estimate,
            P_value = cor_test$p.value,
            N = sum(complete_cases),
            Data_type = data_name,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          ))
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  if(nrow(results) > 0) {
    results$P_adj <- p.adjust(results$P_value, method = "BH")
    results$Significant <- ifelse(results$P_adj < 0.05, "Yes", "No")
  }
  
  return(results)
}

# 4. Run tests
# Food groups
food_group_cols <- colnames(food_data)[-1]
genus_groups <- test_associations(merged_groups, food_group_cols, "Food_Group")

# Food items
food_item_cols <- colnames(food_data_250)[3:ncol(food_data_250)]  # Skip participant_id and freg0_pid
genus_items <- test_associations(merged_items, food_item_cols, "Food_Item")

# Combine results
all_results <- rbind(genus_groups, genus_items)

# 5. Create Excel file
wb <- createWorkbook()

# Sheet 1: All results
addWorksheet(wb, "All_Associations")
all_results_sorted <- all_results %>%
  arrange(Data_type, P_adj, desc(abs(Correlation))) %>%
  mutate(Direction = ifelse(Correlation > 0, "Positive", "Negative"))
writeData(wb, "All_Associations", all_results_sorted)

# Sheet 2: Food Groups only
addWorksheet(wb, "Food_Groups")
food_groups_sig <- genus_groups %>%
  arrange(P_adj, desc(abs(Correlation))) %>%
  mutate(Direction = ifelse(Correlation > 0, "Positive", "Negative"))
writeData(wb, "Food_Groups", food_groups_sig)

# Sheet 3: Food Items only
addWorksheet(wb, "Food_Items")
food_items_sig <- genus_items %>%
  arrange(P_adj, desc(abs(Correlation))) %>%
  mutate(Direction = ifelse(Correlation > 0, "Positive", "Negative"))
writeData(wb, "Food_Items", food_items_sig)

# Sheet 4: Significant only (FDR < 0.05)
addWorksheet(wb, "Significant_FDR_0.05")
sig_results <- all_results %>%
  filter(P_adj < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(Data_type, P_adj, desc(abs(Correlation))) %>%
  mutate(Direction = ifelse(Correlation > 0, "Positive", "Negative"))
writeData(wb, "Significant_FDR_0.05", sig_results)

# Sheet 5: Summary
addWorksheet(wb, "Summary")
summary_data <- data.frame(
  Category = c("Pseudomonas columns used", 
               "Food groups tested", 
               "Food items tested",
               "Total associations",
               "Significant food groups (FDR<0.05)",
               "Significant food items (FDR<0.05)",
               "Analysis date"),
  Value = c(length(pseudomonas_cols),
            nrow(genus_groups),
            nrow(genus_items),
            nrow(all_results),
            sum(genus_groups$P_adj < 0.05),
            sum(genus_items$P_adj < 0.05),
            as.character(Sys.time()))
)
writeData(wb, "Summary", summary_data)

# 6. Save Excel file
excel_file <- file.path(output_dir, "Pseudomonas_genus_associations.xlsx")
saveWorkbook(wb, excel_file, overwrite = TRUE)

cat("Analysis complete!\n")
cat("Excel file saved to:", excel_file, "\n")
cat("\nSheets created:\n")
cat("1. All_Associations - All results\n")
cat("2. Food_Groups - Food group results only\n")
cat("3. Food_Items - Food item results only\n")
cat("4. Significant_FDR_0.05 - Only FDR < 0.05\n")
cat("5. Summary - Analysis summary\n")
```
